_comment: The comparison step of one iPhone SE 3 review round. See .kit/lib/mobile/roundCompare.mjs.
KAGEROU's harness is still on a branch: PR #8 (agent/iphone-se3-automation) and PR #9
(agent/round-phone-gates) both add tools/test-iphone-webkit.mjs, and they overlap with each
other. This file deliberately touches neither, so it merges with whichever lands.
The paths below are the ones PR #9 emits. PR #8 emits the same shape except that neither
spells the maximum frame gap the way the other two repositories do — PR #9 writes
soak.maxFrameGapMs where Gptgame and survival write soak.maximumFrameGapMs. Both spellings
are declared; the absent one is reported as notMeasured rather than scored as zero.
Until a harness exists on main, `--bootstrap` will correctly refuse: there is no report to
record. That refusal is the intended behaviour, not a gap to work around.
Nothing here is evidence about a physical iPhone SE 3.
